title: Score
description: A weighted assessment of a market or asset. Every score is reproducible from committed data plus committed config: components carry their evidence and confidence, weights come from config rather than code, and the weight set used is recorded so a ranking can always be explained and re-derived.

weight_set_id.description: Which weighting profile produced this score. Rankings are only comparable within the same weight set.

component_key.description: e.g. affordability, snow_reliability, tourism_growth, town_vibe, regulation, infrastructure, future_supply_balance, exit_liquidity, risk.

rationale.description: Why this value, in a sentence. A score without a rationale is an opinion in numeric costume.

overall_confidence.description: Propagated from components. A total built on low-confidence parts is low confidence, never silently averaged into apparent certainty.

components_missing.description: Components that could not be scored for want of data. Listed rather than defaulted to a middle value, which would flatter incomplete markets.

disqualified.description: Set where a gating criterion fails, e.g. the operating model is not legal in this market. A disqualified subject is excluded regardless of total score.
